title: Public area string extraction
summary: Public chrome, dashboard, profile, legal/help, Recruitment Open roles / My applications, and Pet Profiles labels now come from UK English lang files. Glossary wording for Open roles and My applications is unchanged in meaning.
changes: Move dashboard, profile, onboarding flash, legal/help, chrome, branded errors, and change-log copy into lang/en_GB/public.php.
Move public Recruitment board and My applications copy into recruitment::public.* plugin keys; keep terms.open_roles / terms.my_applications for nav labels.
Move Pet Profiles public UI labels into pet_profiles::ui.* plugin keys.
Clear the public hard-coded string inventory section to 0 (Blade fragment false positives allow-listed).
affected_areas: Recruitment Open roles and My applications
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.38.x Language line: public-area extraction after Admin shell extract (0.38.5).
validation: php artisan lang:inventory — public section count 0.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: APES CIC staff hub, Cases, Tickets, and staff recruitment strings remain hard-coded until #269.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Public UI returns to prior hard-coded English if lang keys are removed; no database migrations are included.
